explication: IPTV is a community-maintained collection of public live-stream links, organized as M3U playlists. Contributors submit stream add, edit, or removal requests; validation checks requests against the channel database and existing playlists, and the update command applies approved changes. Playlist commands also support editing, formatting, validation, export, and generation of catalog-oriented playlist outputs. The README additionally documents a separate EPG project and API/database repositories, not runtime components shown here. Links between unsampled commands and generators are omitted where their wiring is not evidenced.
